name: transit-1.0.0
description: Multi-modal transit routing via Google Maps — subway, bus, train, walking, driving, bicycling

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Plan a transit trip with step-by-step directions, transfers, departure/arrival times. Supports subway, bus, commuter rail, walking. Returns up to 3 route alternatives.

arrive_by.description: ISO datetime or time string to arrive by (e.g. '2025-01-15T15:00:00')

depart_at.description: ISO datetime or 'now' for departure time

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Get simple turn-by-turn directions between two locations with duration and distance.

mode.description: Travel mode: transit, driving, walking, bicycling (default: transit)

tools.name: nearby_transit
tools.description: Find nearby transit stations (subway, bus, train) from a location.

location.description: Address or place name to search near

env.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
env.description: Google Maps Platform API key with Directions, Geocoding, and Places APIs enabled
